title: Vendor contacts
summary: Who gets each vendor's PO from Send PO, and who is copied.

items: Open Setup › **Vendor contacts** (or Contacts on a vendor in the cart).
Add each email address for the vendor, with a name if you like.
Tick **Gets POs** for the addresses that should receive orders.
Add default **CC** addresses (up to 10) for people who should always get a copy.
Send PO can only email addresses saved here. CC on a single send can be any address.
Only admins add or change contacts. Anyone with the cart can send.
**Recent PO sends** lists every send: who, when, to whom, CC, and whether it went out. **Download** gets that PO as Excel, PDF or CSV.

blocks.text: Contacts are real people's details, so the demo login never sees this page.
